en.s: The Battle of Liantai (simplified Chinese: 廉台之战; traditional Chinese: 廉台之戰; pinyin: Liántái zhī zhàn) was fought between the states of Former Yan and Ran Wei on 17 May 352 AD during the Sixteen Kingdoms period of China. The battle concluded with the capture of the Wei emperor, Ran Min and a decisive victory for the Yan, establishing the Murong-Xianbei as the dominant power on the Central Plains for years to come.

zh.s: 廉台之战（简体中文：廉台之战；繁体中文：廉台之戰；拼音：Liántái zhī zhàn）发生于公元352年5月17日，是十六国时期前燕与冉魏之间的一场战役。此战以冉魏皇帝冉闵被俘、前燕取得决定性胜利告终，慕容鲜卑由此确立了其后多年在中原的主导地位。

en.s: The second Battle of Ramla (or Ramleh) took place on 17 May 1102 between the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem and the Fatimids of Egypt.

zh.s: 第二次拉姆拉战役于1102年5月17日爆发，交战双方是耶路撒冷十字军王国和埃及法蒂玛王朝。

en.s: The Battle of Rovine took place on 17 May 1395. The Wallachian army led by Voivod Mircea the Elder opposed the Ottoman invasion personally led by Sultan Bayezid I the Thunderbolt. The Turkish force heavily outnumbered the Wallachian troops. The legend says that on the eve of the battle, dressed as a peace emissary, Mircea cel Bătrân talked to Bayezid asking him to leave Wallachia and promised him safe passage back.

zh.s: 罗维讷战役发生于1395年5月17日。由老米尔恰亲自率领的瓦拉几亚军队抵抗奥斯曼帝国入侵，奥斯曼军由“雷霆”巴耶济德一世苏丹亲自统率。土耳其军队人数远多于瓦拉几亚军队。传说战役前夜，老米尔恰乔装成求和使者，劝巴耶济德离开瓦拉几亚，并承诺护送他安全返回。

en.t: Edward Stafford, 3rd Duke of Buckingham, is executed for treason
en.s: Edward Stafford, 3rd Duke of Buckingham KG KB (3 February 1478 – 17 May 1521), was an English nobleman. He was the son of Henry Stafford, 2nd Duke of Buckingham, and Katherine Woodville, and nephew of Elizabeth Woodville and King Edward IV. Thus, Edward Stafford was a first cousin once removed of King Henry VIII. He frequently attended the courts of Henry VII and Henry VIII.

zh.t: 第三代白金汉公爵爱德华·斯塔福德因叛国罪被处决
zh.s: 第三代白金汉公爵爱德华·斯塔福德（1478年2月3日—1521年5月17日）是英格兰贵族。他是第二代白金汉公爵亨利·斯塔福德与凯瑟琳·伍德维尔之子，也是伊丽莎白·伍德维尔和爱德华四世国王的外甥。因此，他是亨利八世国王隔一代的表亲。他经常出入亨利七世和亨利八世的宫廷。

en.t: Pánfilo de Narváez departs Spain to explore Florida with 600 men – by 1536 only four survive
en.s: Pánfilo de Narváez (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈpaɱfilo ðe naɾˈβaeθ]; born 1478, died 1528) was a Spanish conquistador and soldier in the Americas. Born in Spain, he first sailed to the island of Jamaica (then Santiago) in 1510 as a soldier. Pánfilo participated in the conquest of Cuba and led an expedition to Camagüey, escorting Bartolomé de las Casas.

zh.t: 潘菲洛·德·纳尔瓦埃斯率600人离开西班牙前往佛罗里达探险，至1536年仅4人幸存
zh.s: 潘菲洛·德·纳尔瓦埃斯（西班牙语发音：[ˈpaɱfilo ðe naɾˈβaeθ]；1478年生，1528年去世）是西班牙征服者和美洲军人。他出生于西班牙，1510年首次以士兵身份航行至牙买加岛（当时称圣地亚哥）。他参与征服古巴，并率领远征队前往卡马圭，为巴托洛梅·德·拉斯·卡萨斯护航。

en.s: The siege of Steinvikholm was a siege of Steinvikholm Castle in Stjørdalen, Norway (in the Skatval area in the present day Stjørdal Municipality). The siege was between the forces of the Catholic Deacon Knud Pederson Skanke and noble Tord Roed. The siege started in April after the Archbishop of Norway Olav Engelbrektsson had fled the country. The protestant forces laid siege to the castle and did a naval blockade of the fjord.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 斯泰因维克霍尔姆城堡围城战（1537年）
zh.s: 斯泰因维克霍尔姆围城战发生在挪威斯托达伦的斯泰因维克霍尔姆城堡（今斯托达尔市辖下的斯卡特瓦尔地区）。交战双方是天主教执事克努德·佩德松·斯坎克所部和贵族托尔德·罗德所部。挪威大主教奥拉夫·恩格尔布雷克松逃离该国后，围城战于4月开始。新教军队围攻城堡，并封锁峡湾。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Kannauj or Battle of Bilgram also known as Battle of Ganges took place at Kannauj, Uttar Pradesh, India between Sher Shah Suri and Humayun on 17 May 1540. This conflict occurred near Bilgram, where Humayun was defeated.

zh.s: 坎瑙季战役又称比尔格拉姆战役或恒河战役，于1540年5月17日在印度北方邦坎瑙季附近爆发，交战双方是舍尔·沙阿·苏里和胡马雍。战斗发生在比尔格拉姆附近，胡马雍战败。

en.t: Anne of Denmark is crowned Queen of Scotland
en.s: Anne of Denmark (Danish: Anna; 12 December 1574 – 2 March 1619) was Queen of Scotland from her marriage to King James VI on 20 August 1589, and Queen of England and Ireland from the union of the Scottish and English Crowns on 24 March 1603, until her death in 1619. The second daughter of King Frederick II of Denmark and Sophie of Mecklenburg-Güstrow, Anne married James at age 14.

zh.t: 丹麦的安妮加冕为苏格兰王后
zh.s: 丹麦的安妮（丹麦语：Anna；1574年12月12日—1619年3月2日）于1589年8月20日与苏格兰国王詹姆斯六世结婚后成为苏格兰王后。1603年3月24日，苏格兰和英格兰王冠合并，她成为英格兰和爱尔兰王后，直至1619年去世。她是丹麦国王弗雷德里克二世与梅克伦堡-居斯特罗的索菲之次女，14岁时嫁给詹姆斯。

en.s: The Siege of Fellin took place between March 25 and 17 May 1602 during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611). Polish and Lithuanian forces led by Grand Crown Hetman Jan Zamoyski besieged the Swedish-held town of Fellin (present day Viljandi in Estonia). The large Polish–Lithuanian army of around 5,000 troops first took the town, while the Swedish defenders, numbering around 800, retreated to the city's castle. After a second frontal attack on the castle, during which the Voivode of Wenden Jerzy Farensbach was killed, the Swedish garrison capitulated, although a group of Finnish soldiers refused to surrender and blew themselves up in the castle's tower.

zh.s: 费林围城战发生于1602年3月25日至5月17日，是波瑞战争（1600—1611年）的一部分。扬·扎莫伊斯基大王冠赫特曼率领波兰和立陶宛军队围攻瑞典控制的费林镇（今爱沙尼亚维尔扬迪）。约5000人的波兰—立陶宛大军先攻下镇子，约800名瑞典守军退守城堡。第二次正面攻城时，文登省省长耶日·法伦斯巴赫阵亡，瑞典守军随后投降。不过，一队芬兰士兵拒绝投降，在城堡塔楼内引爆炸药自尽。

en.s: The Tunisian–Algerian War of 1628 was a conflict between the regencies of Algiers and Tunis arising from territorial disputes. The casus belli involved the construction, by the Tunisians, of a military post along the river intended to demarcate the territory between the two regencies.

zh.s: 1628年突尼斯和阿尔及尔摄政区之间因领土争端爆发战争。导火索是突尼斯人沿河修建军事哨所，意在划定两个摄政区之间的边界。

en.s: The Treaty of Zuhab (Persian: عهدنامه زهاب, romanized: Ahadnāmeh-ye Zuhab), also called Treaty of Qasr-e Shirin (Turkish: Kasr-ı Şirin Antlaşması), signed on 17 May 1639 at Qasr-e Shirin in western Iran, ended the Ottoman–Safavid War of 1623–1639. It strove to clarify territorial divisions and borders between the Safavid and Ottoman Empires, serving as an important document for future agreements.

zh.s: 祖哈卜条约（波斯语：عهدنامه زهاب，罗马化：Ahadnāmeh-ye Zuhab），又称卡斯尔希林条约（土耳其语：Kasr-ı Şirin Antlaşması），于1639年5月17日在伊朗西部的卡斯尔希林签署，结束了1623年至1639年的奥斯曼—萨法维战争。条约旨在明确萨法维帝国与奥斯曼帝国之间的领土划分和边界，并成为后来相关协议的重要依据。

en.s: The Spanish and Portuguese conquest of Providencia took place on 17 May 1641 and was an amphibious expedition against the Piracy in the Caribbean in order to seize the island from its English settlers' control. The Spanish and Portuguese fleet carrying 2,000 men captured the island and took so much gold and slaves that the value of the plunder was estimated at above half a million ducats.

zh.t: 伊比利亚军队夺取普罗维登西亚岛
zh.s: 西班牙和葡萄牙于1641年5月17日联合远征普罗维登西亚岛，目标是从英国定居者手中夺取该岛，打击加勒比海海盗活动。载有2,000名士兵的西葡舰队攻占该岛，并掠得大量黄金和奴隶，战利品估值超过50万达克特。

en.s: The Battle of Zusmarshausen was fought on 17 May 1648 between the Holy Roman Empire and Sweden and France (led by Henri de la Tour d'Auvergne, Vicomte de Turenne) in the modern Augsburg district of Bavaria, Germany. The Swedish-French force was victorious, and the Imperial army barely escaped annihilation. The French army, led by Turenne, first captured several pieces of artillery, before they met up with the Swedish army.

zh.s: 祖斯马斯豪森战役于1648年5月17日在现代德国巴伐利亚州奥格斯堡县爆发，交战双方是神圣罗马帝国与瑞典、法国联军。联军由亨利·德·拉图尔·多韦尔涅子爵图雷纳率领，最终获胜，帝国军险些全军覆没。法军先缴获多门火炮，随后与瑞典军会合。

en.s: The Battle of Chotusitz, or Chotusice, sometimes called the Battle of Czaslau, was fought on May 17, 1742, in Bohemia between the Austrians under Prince Charles Alexander of Lorraine and the Prussians under Frederick the Great. The battle was a part of the War of the Austrian Succession sometimes referred to as the First Silesian War. The armies were about equal at 28,000 to 30,000 each, with the Prussians having about 2,000 more infantry and the Austrians some 2,000 more cavalry. The Austrians were attempting to retake occupied Prague and the Prussians were trying to block them from accomplishing that.

zh.s: 霍图西采战役又称恰斯劳战役，于1742年5月17日在波希米亚爆发，交战双方是洛林亲王查理·亚历山大的奥地利军和腓特烈大帝率领的普鲁士军。这是奥地利王位继承战争的一部分，有时也称第一次西里西亚战争。双方兵力大致相当，各约28,000至30,000人；普军步兵多约2,000人，奥军骑兵则多约2,000人。奥军试图夺回被占领的布拉格，普军则想阻止他们。

en.s: The Seven Years' War, 1756 to 1763, was a global war fought by numerous great powers, primarily in Europe, with significant subsidiary campaigns in North America and the Indian subcontinent. The primary warring states were Great Britain and Prussia fighting against France and Austria, with other countries joining these coalitions: Portugal, Spain, Sweden, and Russia, plus Saxony and many other minor states of the Holy Roman Empire.

zh.s: 七年战争（1756—1763年）是一场由多个大国参与的全球性战争，战事主要发生在欧洲，在北美和印度次大陆也有重要战役。主要交战国是英国和普鲁士，对阵法国和奥地利；葡萄牙、西班牙、瑞典和俄罗斯也加入了这些联盟，神圣罗马帝国境内的萨克森及许多小邦同样参战。

en.s: The siege of Quebec, also known as the second siege of Quebec, was a 1760 French attempt to retake Quebec City, in New France, which had been captured by Britain the previous year. The siege lasted from 29 April to 15 May, when British ships arrived to relieve the city and compelled the French commander, François Gaston de Lévis, to break off the siege and to retreat.

zh.s: 魁北克围城战又称第二次魁北克围城战，是法国于1760年试图夺回新法兰西魁北克市的一次行动；该城前一年被英国占领。围城于1760年4月29日至5月15日持续进行。英国舰船抵达增援后，迫使法国指挥官弗朗索瓦·加斯东·德·莱维解除围城并撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Thomas Creek, or the Thomas Creek Massacre (May 17, 1777), was an ambush of a small force of Georgia militia cavalry by a mixed force of British Army, Loyalist militia, and Indians near the mouth of Thomas Creek in northern East Florida. The encounter was the only major engagement in the second of three failed attempts by American forces to invade East Florida in the early years of the American Revolutionary War. The invasion attempt consisted of a naval flotilla carrying Continental Army troops and a company of militia cavalry traveling overland.

zh.s: 托马斯溪战役又称托马斯溪大屠杀，于1777年5月17日发生在东佛罗里达北部托马斯溪河口附近。一支规模不大的佐治亚民兵骑兵部队遭到英军、效忠派民兵和原住民组成的混合部队伏击。这是美国独立战争初期美军三次入侵东佛罗里达失败行动中的第二次行动里唯一一场主要交战。此次入侵计划由海上舰队运送大陆军士兵，同时派一支民兵骑兵连陆路前进。

en.s: The Buttonwood Agreement is the founding document of what is now the New York Stock Exchange and is one of the most important financial documents in U.S. history. The agreement organized securities trading in New York City and was signed on May 17, 1792 between 24 stockbrokers outside of 68 Wall Street. According to legend the signing took place under a buttonwood tree where their earliest transactions had occurred.

zh.s: 梧桐树协议是现今纽约证券交易所的创立文件，也是美国历史上最重要的金融文件之一。协议于1792年5月17日由24名证券经纪人在纽约市华尔街68号外签署，确立了纽约的证券交易安排。传说签署地点在一棵梧桐树下，早期交易曾在那里进行。

en.s: The French invasion of Switzerland (German: Franzoseneinfall) occurred from January to May 1798 as part of the French Revolutionary Wars. The independent Old Swiss Confederacy collapsed from the invasion and simultaneous internal revolts called the "Helvetic Revolution". The Swiss ancien régime institutions were abolished and replaced by the centralised Helvetic Republic, one of the sister republics of the French First Republic.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法国入侵瑞士（德语：Franzoseneinfall）发生于1798年1月至5月，是法国大革命战争的一部分。入侵及同时发生的内部起义“赫尔维蒂革命”导致旧瑞士邦联解体。瑞士旧制度的机构被废除，取而代之的是中央集权的赫尔维蒂共和国，该共和国是法兰西第一共和国的姊妹共和国之一。

en.s: The Battle of Linz-Urfahr on 17 May 1809 saw soldiers from the Austrian Empire fighting against troops from two of Emperor Napoleon's allies, the Kingdom of Württemberg and the Kingdom of Saxony. An Austrian corps led by Feldzeugmeister Johann Kollowrat attacked General of Division Dominique Vandamme's Württembergers who held a fortified bridgehead on the north bank of the Danube opposite the city of Linz. As the combat got underway, Saxons led by Marshal Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte began reinforcing the defenders. This prompted Kollowrat to order a retreat, which was followed up by Napoleon's German allies.

zh.s: 林茨—乌尔法尔战役于1809年5月17日爆发，交战双方是奥地利帝国军队和拿破仑两位盟友——符腾堡王国和萨克森王国的军队。约翰·科洛拉特炮兵将军率领奥军军团，进攻多米尼克·旺达姆师级将军麾下的符腾堡军；后者守在林茨对岸、多瑙河北岸的一处防御桥头堡。战斗开始后，若望-巴蒂斯特·贝尔纳多特元帅率领萨克森军增援守军。科洛拉特因此下令撤退，拿破仑的德意志盟友随后追击。

en.t: Emperor Napoleon I orders the annexation of the Papal States to the French Empire
en.s: The Papal States ( PAY-pəl), officially the State of the Church, were a conglomeration of territories on the Italian Peninsula under the direct sovereign rule of the pope from 756 to 1870. They were among the major Italian states from the 8th century until the unification of Italy, which took place between 1859 and 1870, culminating in their incorporation into the Kingdom of Italy.

zh.t: 拿破仑一世下令将教皇国并入法兰西帝国
zh.s: 教皇国正式名称为教会国，是756年至1870年间位于意大利半岛、由教皇直接统治的一组领土。自8世纪起，它一直是重要的意大利邦国之一，直至1859年至1870年意大利统一，并最终并入意大利王国。

en.s: The Constitution of Norway (complete name: The Constitution of the Kingdom of Norway; Danish: Kongeriget Norges Grundlov; Norwegian Bokmål: Kongeriket Norges Grunnlov; Norwegian Nynorsk: Kongeriket Noregs Grunnlov) was adopted on 16 May and signed on 17 May 1814 by the Norwegian Constituent Assembly at Eidsvoll. The latter date is the National Day of Norway; it marks the establishment of the constitution.

zh.s: 挪威宪法的全称为《挪威王国宪法》（丹麦语：Kongeriget Norges Grundlov；书面挪威语：Kongeriket Norges Grunnlov；新挪威语：Kongeriket Noregs Grunnlov）。宪法于1814年5月16日由挪威制宪会议通过，并于5月17日在埃兹沃尔签署。5月17日是挪威国庆日，用以纪念宪法确立。

en.s: The Battle of San Germano (or the Battle of Mignano) was the final battle in the Neapolitan War between an Austrian force commanded by Laval Nugent von Westmeath and the King of Naples, Joachim Murat. The battle started on 15 May 1815 and ended on 17 May, after the remaining Neapolitan force was routed at Mignano. Following his defeat at the Battle of Tolentino, Murat had fallen back to San Germano, now Cassino.

zh.s: 圣日耳曼诺战役又称米尼亚诺战役，是那不勒斯战争的最后一场战役，交战双方为拉瓦尔·纽金特·冯·韦斯特米思率领的奥地利军队和那不勒斯国王约阿希姆·缪拉。战斗于1815年5月15日开始，至5月17日结束；那不勒斯残余部队在米尼亚诺被击溃。托伦蒂诺战役战败后，缪拉退守圣日耳曼诺（今卡西诺）。

en.s: The Battle of the San Gabriels was an 1839 skirmish in the Texas–Indian wars. The battle began on 17 May 1839. A company of Texas Rangers under Lt. James O. Rice had pursued the Mexican agent Manuel Flores and his party of Mexicans and Indians, following their murder of four surveyors working between Seguin and San Antonio, Texas.

zh.s: 圣加布里埃尔战役是1839年得克萨斯—印第安战争期间的一场小规模交战，于1839年5月17日打响。詹姆斯·O·赖斯中尉率领一支得克萨斯游骑兵连，追捕墨西哥特工曼努埃尔·弗洛雷斯及其带领的墨西哥人和原住民队伍。此前，这伙人杀害了四名测量员，他们当时在得克萨斯州塞金和圣安东尼奥之间作业。

en.s: The Battle of Pine Creek, also known as the Battle of Tohotonimme and the Steptoe Disaster, was a conflict between United States Army forces under Brevet Lieutenant Colonel Edward Steptoe and members of the Coeur d'Alene, Palouse and Spokane Native American tribes. It took place on May 17, 1858, near what is present-day Rosalia, Washington. The Native Americans were victorious.

zh.s: 松溪战役又称托霍托尼姆战役和斯特普托灾难，是美国陆军布雷维特中校爱德华·斯特普托所部与科达伦、帕卢斯和斯波坎原住民部族之间的一场冲突。战役于1858年5月17日在今华盛顿州罗萨利亚附近爆发，原住民一方获胜。

en.s: The Siege of Puebla occurred between 16 March and 17 May 1863 during the French Intervention in Mexico, between forces of the Second French Empire and forces of the Second Federal Republic of Mexico. The French were advancing toward Mexico City, and were blocked by Mexican troops at Puebla. The French encircled the city, and attempted to take it by storm, but failed. The French defeated several Mexican relief attempts, and after several weeks the city fell, a French victory.

zh.s: 普埃布拉围城战于1863年3月16日至5月17日进行，是法国干涉墨西哥期间第二法兰西帝国与墨西哥第二联邦共和国军队之间的战斗。法军向墨西哥城推进时，在普埃布拉遭到墨军阻拦。法军包围该城并试图强攻，但未能成功。墨军多次尝试解围，均被法军击退。数周后，普埃布拉陷落，法军获胜。

en.t: Battle of Big Black River Bridge
en.s: The Battle of Big Black River Bridge, or Big Black, fought May 17, 1863, was part of the Vicksburg Campaign of the American Civil War. Union commander Maj. Gen. Ulysses S. Grant and the Army of the Tennessee pursued the retreating Confederate Lt. Gen. John C. Pemberton following the Battle of Champion Hill, in the final battle before the Siege of Vicksburg.

zh.s: 大黑河桥战役又称大黑河之战，于1863年5月17日爆发，是美国内战维克斯堡战役的一部分。尤利西斯·S·格兰特少将率联邦军田纳西军团，在冠军山战役后追击由约翰·C·彭伯顿中将率领的撤退邦联军。这是维克斯堡围城战前的最后一场战斗。

en.t: Rosalía de Castro publishes Cantares Gallegos, the first book in the Galician language
en.s: María Rosalía Rita de Castro (Galician pronunciation: [rosaˈli.ɐ ðɪ ˈkastɾʊ]; 23 February 1837 – 15 July 1885), was a Galician poet and novelist, considered one of the most important figures of the 19th-century Spanish literature and modern lyricism. Widely regarded as the greatest Galician cultural icon, she was a leading figure in the emergence of the literary Galician language.

zh.t: 罗萨莉娅·德·卡斯特罗出版首部加利西亚语书籍《加利西亚歌谣》
zh.s: 玛丽亚·罗萨莉娅·丽塔·德·卡斯特罗（加利西亚语发音：[rosaˈli.ɐ ðɪ ˈkastɾʊ]；1837年2月23日—1885年7月15日）是加利西亚诗人和小说家，被视为19世纪西班牙文学和现代抒情诗的重要人物之一。她广受推崇，被认为是最具代表性的加利西亚文化象征，也是加利西亚语文学兴起的重要人物。

en.s: The Battle of Adairsville was a part of the Atlanta campaign fought during the American Civil War on May 17, 1864, just northeast of Rome, Georgia. The brief engagement was a Confederate delaying action that allowed General Joseph E. Johnston to bait a trap for the Union army at Cassville.

zh.s: 阿代尔斯维尔战役是美国内战期间亚特兰大战役的一部分，于1864年5月17日在佐治亚州罗马东北部不远处发生。这场短暂交战是南方邦联军的一次迟滞行动，使约瑟夫·E·约翰斯顿将军得以在卡斯维尔为联邦军设下圈套。

en.s: The Battle of Rome Cross Roads, also known as Battle of Rome Crossroads, Skirmish at Rome Crossroads, or Action at Rome Cross-Roads was part of the Atlanta campaign of the American Civil War. It was fought in Gordon County, Georgia, a short distance west of Calhoun, Georgia, on May 16, 1864.

zh.s: 罗马十字路口战役也称罗马十字路口小冲突或罗马十字道路行动，是美国内战亚特兰大战役的一部分。战斗于1864年5月16日在佐治亚州戈登县发生，地点在卡尔霍恩以西不远处。

en.t: The International Telegraph Union (later the International Telecommunication Union) is established in Paris
en.s: The International Telecommunication Union (ITU) is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for many matters related to information and communication technologies. It was established on 17 May 1865 as the International Telegraph Union, the first formal and permanent international organization. The organization significantly predates the UN, making it the oldest UN agency. Doreen Bogdan-Martin is the current secretary-general of the ITU, the first woman to serve as its head.

zh.t: 国际电报联盟（后更名为国际电信联盟）在巴黎成立
zh.s: 国际电信联盟（ITU）是联合国专门机构，负责信息和通信技术领域的多项事务。该组织于1865年5月17日以国际电报联盟之名成立，是第一个正式、常设的国际组织。它成立时间远早于联合国，是联合国最古老的专门机构。多琳·博格丹-马丁是ITU现任秘书长，也是该组织首位女性负责人。

en.s: Geronimo Campaign, between May 1885 and September 1886, was the last large-scale military operation of the Apache wars. It took more than 5,000 U.S. Army Cavalry soldiers, led by the two experienced Army generals, in order to subdue no more than 70 (only 38 by the end of the campaign in northern Mexico) Chiricahua Apache who fled the San Carlos Apache Indian Reservation and raided parts of the surrounding Arizona Territory and adjacent Sonora state in Mexico for more than a year.

zh.s: 杰罗尼莫战役发生于1885年5月至1886年9月，是阿帕奇战争中最后一次大规模军事行动。美国陆军派出5,000多名骑兵，由两位经验丰富的将军率领，试图制服最多70名（到战役结束时只剩38名）奇里卡瓦阿帕奇人。他们逃离圣卡洛斯阿帕奇保留地后，在亚利桑那领地及墨西哥索诺拉州周边地区袭扰一年多。

en.s: The Battle of Domokos (Turkish: Dömeke muharebesi) took place between the Ottoman Empire and the Kingdom of Greece. This battle was a part of the Greco-Turkish War (1897). The battle resulted in an Ottoman victory, and prompted European powers to intervene on behalf of Greece to prevent further Ottoman advances into Greek territory.

zh.s: 多莫科斯战役（土耳其语：Dömeke muharebesi）是奥斯曼帝国与希腊王国之间的一场战斗，属于1897年希土战争的一部分。奥斯曼帝国获胜，欧洲列强随后出面支持希腊，以阻止奥斯曼军队进一步进入希腊领土。

en.t: The children's novel The Wonderful Wizard of Oz, by L. Frank Baum, is first published in the United States. The first copy is given to the author's sister
en.s: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz is a 1900 children's fantasy novel written by the American author L. Frank Baum and illustrated by W. W. Denslow. It is the first novel in the Oz series of books. A Kansas farm girl named Dorothy ends up in the magical Land of Oz after she and her pet dog Toto are swept away from their home by a cyclone.

zh.t: L.弗兰克·鲍姆的儿童小说《绿野仙踪》在美国首次出版，第一本赠给作者的妹妹
zh.s: 《绿野仙踪》是L.弗兰克·鲍姆创作、W. W.丹斯洛插图的儿童奇幻小说，出版于1900年，也是奥兹系列的第一部作品。堪萨斯州农场女孩多萝西和她的宠物狗托托被旋风卷离家园，来到神奇的奥兹国。

en.t: The Antikythera mechanism, the oldest known surviving geared mechanism, was discovered among artifacts retrieved from a shipwreck off the Greek island of Antikythera
en.s: The Antikythera mechanism ( AN-tik-ih-THEER-ə, US also AN-ty-kih-) is an ancient Greek hand-powered orrery (model of the Solar System) built in the 2nd century BC and discovered in 1901. It is the oldest known example of an analogue computer. It could be used to predict astronomical positions and eclipses decades in advance. It could also be used to track the four-year cycle of athletic games similar to an olympiad, the cycle of the ancient Olympic Games.

zh.t: 希腊安提基西拉岛附近沉船遗物中发现安提基西拉机械，这是已知现存最古老的齿轮装置
zh.s: 安提基西拉机械（读作 AN-tik-ih-THEER-ə；美国也读作 AN-ty-kih-）是一种古希腊手动操作的天体仪（太阳系模型），建于公元前2世纪，1901年被发现。它是现存已知最早的模拟计算机，可用于提前数十年预测天体位置和日食，也可追踪类似奥林匹克运动会的四年一度体育赛事周期。

en.t: 1907 Cisleithanian legislative election in the Kingdom of Dalmatia
en.s: Elections to the Cisleithanian Imperial Council were held in the Kingdom of Dalmatia on 17 May 1907 to elect the eleven Dalmatian members of the Imperial Council as part of the wider Cisleithanian elections. The eleven members were elected from single-seat constituencies by universal male suffrage.

zh.t: 1907年达尔马提亚王国西斯莱塔尼亚议会选举
zh.s: 1907年5月17日，达尔马提亚王国举行西斯莱塔尼亚帝国议会选举，选出达尔马提亚的11名帝国议会议员，这是更大范围的西斯莱塔尼亚选举的一部分。11名议员由男性普选产生，每个单一席位选区选出一人。

en.s: The Protocol of Corfu (Greek: Πρωτόκολλο της Κέρκυρας, Albanian: Protokolli i Korfuzit), signed on 17 May 1914, was an agreement between the representatives of the Albanian Government and the Provisional Government of Northern Epirus, which officially recognized the area of Northern Epirus as an autonomous self-governing region under the sovereignty of the prince of the newly established Principality of Albania.

zh.s: 科孚议定书（希腊语：Πρωτόκολλο της Κέρκυρας；阿尔巴尼亚语：Protokolli i Korfuzit）于1914年5月17日签署，是阿尔巴尼亚政府代表与北伊庇鲁斯临时政府代表之间达成的协议。协议正式承认北伊庇鲁斯地区为自治区域，在主权上仍隶属新成立的阿尔巴尼亚公国，其君主为阿尔巴尼亚亲王。

en.s: French occupation of Frankfurt occurred from 6 April to 17 May 1920 as part of the Allied occupation of the Rhineland. The principal city occupied was Frankfurt, but the French also occupied Dieburg, Darmstadt, Hanau and Homburg. The occupation was in response to the mobilisation of armed forces by the government of Hermann Müller to suppress the Ruhr Uprising, an attempt by left-wing workers to take over political power in the Ruhr Area.

zh.s: 法国占领法兰克福发生于1920年4月6日至5月17日，是协约国占领莱茵兰的一部分。法军占领的主要城市是法兰克福，也占领了迪堡、达姆施塔特、哈瑙和洪堡。此次占领是对赫尔曼·米勒政府动员武装力量镇压鲁尔起义的回应。鲁尔起义是左翼工人试图在鲁尔地区夺取政权的行动。

en.s: The 1936 Bolivian coup d'état, also known as the Socialist Revolution of 1936, was a civil-military coup in Bolivia that deposed President José Luis Tejada Sorzano, bringing an end to traditional political order and bringing forward the period of Military Socialism in the country. On 17 May 1936, following the largest strike movement known until then in Bolivia, the military under the young lieutenant colonel Germán Busch overthrew the government of Tejada.

zh.s: 1936年玻利维亚政变又称1936年社会主义革命，是玻利维亚的一场军民政变，推翻了总统何塞·路易斯·特哈达·索尔萨诺，结束了传统政治秩序，并开启该国的军事社会主义时期。1936年5月17日，在玻利维亚当时最大规模的罢工运动之后，以年轻的中校赫尔曼·布施为首的军方推翻了特哈达政府。

en.s: The German invasion of the Netherlands (Dutch: Duitse aanval op Nederland), otherwise known as the Battle of the Netherlands (Dutch: Slag om Nederland), was a military campaign, part of Case Yellow (German: Fall Gelb), the Nazi German invasion of the Low Countries (Belgium, Luxembourg, and the Netherlands) and France during World War II. The battle lasted from 10 May 1940 until the surrender of the main Dutch forces on 14 May.

en.s: The 1941 Christchurch City mayoral election was held on 17 May. The incumbent, Robert Macfarlane of the Labour Party, did not stand for re-election as he wanted to serve in WWII. Four candidates stood and Ernest Andrews of the conservative Citizens' Association was successful. Andrews was installed on 28 May 1941.

The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method. Andrew Allen, the incumbent Mayor, sought re-election for a second term.

en.s: The 1941 Auckland City mayoral election was part of the New Zealand local elections held that same year. In 1941, elections were held for the Mayor of Auckland plus other local government positions including twenty-one city councillors. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method. The election saw deputy-mayor John Allum defeating the Labour nominee Joe Sayegh who suffered defeat for the third time in succession.

zh.s: 1941年奥克兰市长选举是新西兰当年地方选举的一部分。该年选举选出奥克兰市长和其他地方政府职位，包括21个市议员席位。选举采用通常的简单多数制。副市长约翰·阿勒姆当选，击败工党候选人乔·赛义格。赛义格此前已连续两次竞选失利，这次是第三次。

en.s: The 1942 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on May 17, 1942, that saw Red Star Olympique defeat FC Sète 2–0 thanks to goals by Henri Joncourt at 45 minutes, and Alfred Aston at 72 minutes.

zh.s: 1942年法国杯决赛于1942年5月17日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行。红星奥林匹克队以2比0击败塞特足球俱乐部，亨利·容库尔在第45分钟、阿尔弗雷德·阿斯顿在第72分钟进球。

en.s: Operation Chastise, commonly known as the Dambusters Raid, was an attack on German dams carried out on the night of 16/17 May 1943 by 617 Squadron RAF Bomber Command, later called the Dam Busters, using special bouncing bombs developed by Barnes Wallis. The Möhne and Edersee dams were breached, causing catastrophic flooding of the Ruhr valley and of villages in the Eder valley; the Sorpe Dam sustained only minor damage.

zh.s: 惩戒行动（通常称为“炸坝行动”）是英国皇家空军轰炸机司令部第617中队于1943年5月16日至17日夜间对德国水坝发动的袭击。该中队后来被称为“炸坝者”中队，使用的是巴恩斯·沃利斯研制的特殊弹跳炸弹。默讷水坝和埃德尔水坝被炸开，鲁尔河谷及埃德尔河谷的村庄遭受严重洪水；索尔佩水坝仅受到轻微损坏。

en.s: Operation Transom was an attack by Allied forces against the Japanese-occupied city of Surabaya on the Indonesian island of Java during World War II. Conducted by the British-led Eastern Fleet, the operation took place on 17 May 1944 and involved American and British carrier-based aircraft bombing the city's docks and an oil refinery. An American torpedo bomber was shot down, and two British torpedo bombers were lost in accidents.

zh.s: 运输行动是二战期间盟军对日本占领下的爪哇岛泗水发动的空袭。行动由英国主导的东方舰队实施，于1944年5月17日进行。美国和英国舰载机轰炸了泗水的港口码头和一座炼油厂。一架美国鱼雷轰炸机被击落，两架英国鱼雷轰炸机在事故中损失。

en.s: The 1949 Bulgarian Cup final was the 9th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army). It was contested by Levski Sofia and CSKA Sofia. It took three matches at Yunak Stadium to determine a winner. The first took place on 8 May, the second on 16 May and the third on 17 May 1949.

zh.s: 1949年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事第九届决赛。当时赛事名为苏联军队杯。索菲亚列夫斯基队和索菲亚中央陆军队争夺冠军，双方在尤纳克体育场进行了三场比赛才决出胜负。三场比赛分别于1949年5月8日、16日和17日举行。

en.t: 1949 New York's 20th congressional district special election
en.s: The 1949 New York's 20th congressional district special election was held on May 17, 1949, to elect the United States representative from New York's 20th congressional district. Franklin D. Roosevelt Jr. won the election as the nominee of the Liberal and Four Freedoms parties.

zh.t: 1949年纽约州国会第20选区特别选举
zh.s: 1949年纽约州国会第20选区特别选举于1949年5月17日举行，选出纽约州第20国会选区的美国众议员。富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福二世代表自由党和“四大自由党”参选并获胜。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 17 May 1953. As would be the case with all elections for the remainder of Communist rule, voters were presented with a single list from the Communist Hungarian Working People's Party, comprising Communists and pro-Communist independents. The Working People's Party won 206 of the 298 seats, with the remaining 92 going to independents.

zh.s: 匈牙利于1953年5月17日举行议会选举。此后直到共产党统治结束，每次选举都采用同样方式：选民只能投给由匈牙利劳动人民党提出的单一名单，其中包括共产党人和亲共独立人士。劳动人民党赢得298个席位中的206席，其余92席由独立人士获得。

en.s: The crash of Delta Air Lines Flight 318 was an accident involving a Douglas DC-3 of the American airline Delta Air Lines 13 miles (21 km) east of Marshall, Texas, United States on May 17, 1953, killing all but one of the 20 people on board.

zh.s: 1953年5月17日，达美航空318号班机在美国得克萨斯州马歇尔以东13英里（21公里）处坠毁。事故飞机是一架道格拉斯DC-3客机，机上20人中除1人外全部遇难。

en.s: The 1953 Greek Cup final was the 11th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 17 May 1953 at Leoforos Alexandras Stadium. The contesting teams were Olympiacos and AEK Athens. It was Olympiacos' fourth Greek Cup final and third consecutive in their 28 years of existence and AEK Athens' sixth Greek Cup final in their 29-year history.

zh.s: 1953年希腊杯决赛是该赛事第11届决赛，于1953年5月17日在亚历山大大街体育场举行。参赛双方是奥林匹亚科斯和雅典AEK。对奥林匹亚科斯而言，这是建队28年来第4次闯入希腊杯决赛，也是连续第三年进入决赛；雅典AEK则在建队29年间第6次闯入决赛。

en.t: On May 17, 1954, the Supreme Court issued a unanimous 9–0 decision in favor of the Brown family and the other plaintiffs
en.s: Brown v. Board of Education of Topeka, 347 U.S. 483 (1954), is a landmark decision of the United States Supreme Court that ruled that U.S. state laws establishing racial segregation in public schools violate the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, even if the segregated facilities are equal in quality. The decision partially overruled the Court's 1896 decision Plessy v.

zh.t: 布朗诉托皮卡教育局案作出裁决
zh.s: 1954 年 5 月 17 日，美国最高法院以 9 比 0 一致裁定，支持布朗一家及其他原告。布朗诉托皮卡教育局案是美国最高法院的一项里程碑式判决，裁定各州公立学校实行种族隔离的法律违反《第十四修正案》的平等保护条款，即使隔离学校的设施质量相同也不例外。该判决部分推翻了最高法院 1896 年的普莱西诉弗格森案判决。

en.s: The 1958 Christchurch mayoral election was held to elect a successor to Robert Macfarlane who resigned as Mayor of Christchurch upon his selection as Speaker of the New Zealand House of Representatives. The polling was conducted using the standard first-past-the-post electoral method.

zh.s: 1958年基督城市长选举用于选出罗伯特·麦克法兰的继任者。麦克法兰获选为新西兰众议院议长后辞去市长职务。选举采用通常的简单多数制。

en.s: Operation Carentan and Operation Carentan II were security operations conducted during the Vietnam War by the U.S. 1st and 2nd Brigades, 101st Airborne Division and the 3rd Brigade, 82nd Airborne Division in Thừa Thiên Province, South Vietnam from 18 March to 17 May 1968.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

en.s: Operation Delaware/Operation Lam Son 216 was a joint military operation launched during the Vietnam War. It began on 19 April 1968, with troops from the United States and the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) moving into the A Sầu Valley. The A Sầu Valley was a vital corridor for moving military supplies coming from the Ho Chi Minh Trail and was used by the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) as a staging area for numerous attacks in northern I Corps.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 特拉华行动又称蓝山山逊216行动，是越南战争期间展开的一次联合军事行动。行动于1968年4月19日开始，美国军队和越南共和国军（南越军）部队进入阿绍河谷。阿绍河谷是输送来自胡志明小道的军需物资的重要通道，也被越南人民军用作集结地，以便在第一军区北部发动多次袭击。

en.s: Venera 6 (Russian: Венера-6 meaning Venus 6), or 2V (V-69) No.331, was a Soviet spacecraft, launched towards Venus to obtain atmospheric data. It had an on-orbit dry mass of 1,130 kg (2,490 lb). The spacecraft was very similar to Venera 4 although it was of a stronger design. When the atmosphere of Venus was approached, a capsule with a mass of 405 kilograms (893 lb) was jettisoned from the main spacecraft. This capsule contained scientific instruments. During descent towards the surface of Venus, a parachute opened to slow the rate of descent. For 51 minutes on May 17, 1969, while the capsule was suspended from the parachute, data from the Venusian atmosphere were returned.

zh.s: 金星6号（俄语：Венера-6，意为“金星6号”），又称2V（V-69）3号331，是一艘苏联探测器，任务是飞往金星获取大气数据。其在轨干重为1,130千克（2,490磅）。该探测器与金星4号十分相似，但结构更坚固。接近金星大气层时，探测器释放了一个重405千克（893磅）的舱体，内装科学仪器。下降过程中，舱体打开降落伞以减缓下落速度。1969年5月17日，舱体悬挂在降落伞上期间持续传回金星大气数据，共传输了51分钟。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 17 May 1969 to elect the 78 members of the Legislative Assembly of Queensland. The Country–Liberal Coalition won its fifth consecutive victory since it won government in 1957. It was also the Coalition's first victory under new leader Joh Bjelke-Petersen after the brief premierships of Gordon Chalk and Jack Pizzey, who in turn had succeeded Frank Nicklin when he had retired the previous year.

zh.s: 澳大利亚昆士兰州于1969年5月17日举行选举，选出昆士兰州立法议会的78名议员。乡村党—自由党联盟连续第五次获胜；该联盟自1957年执政以来未尝败绩。这也是联盟在新任领导人约翰·比耶尔克-彼得森带领下首次获胜。此前戈登·查克和杰克·皮齐先后短暂担任州长；他们接替的是上一年退休的弗兰克·尼克林。

en.s: The Dublin and Monaghan bombings of 17 May 1974 were a series of co-ordinated bombings in Dublin and Monaghan, Ireland. Three bombs exploded in Dublin during rush hour and a fourth exploded in Monaghan almost ninety minutes later. They killed 33 civilians and a full-term unborn child, and injured almost 300. The bombings were the deadliest attack of the conflict known as the Troubles, and the deadliest attack in the Republic's history. Most of the victims were young women, although the ages of the dead ranged from five months to 80 years.

zh.t: 都柏林和莫纳亨爆炸案
zh.s: 1974年5月17日，都柏林和莫纳亨发生一系列协同爆炸。都柏林在交通高峰时段发生三起爆炸，约90分钟后莫纳亨又发生第四起。爆炸造成33名平民和一名足月胎儿死亡，近300人受伤。这是“北爱尔兰问题”冲突期间伤亡最惨重的袭击，也是爱尔兰共和国历史上伤亡最惨重的袭击。遇难者大多是年轻女性，年龄最小的仅5个月，最年长者80岁。

en.s: The Battle of Karuma Falls was one of the last battles in the Uganda–Tanzania War, fought between Tanzania and Uganda Army troops loyal to Idi Amin on 17 May 1979. Soldiers of the Tanzania People's Defence Force attacked Ugandan forces at the bridge over the Nile River at Karuma Falls. Tanzania's 205th Brigade was tasked with advancing from Masindi to Gulu, taking a route which passed over the Karuma Falls Bridge.

zh.s: 卡鲁马瀑布战役是乌坦战争末期的战斗之一，于1979年5月17日由坦桑尼亚军队与效忠伊迪·阿明的乌干达军队交战。坦桑尼亚人民国防军士兵攻击了卡鲁马瀑布尼罗河桥上的乌干达部队。坦桑尼亚第205旅奉命从马辛迪向古卢推进，行军路线经过卡鲁马瀑布桥。

en.s: Coup d'état of May Seventeenth was a military coup d'état carried out in South Korea by general Chun Doo-hwan and Hanahoe that followed the Coup d'état of December Twelfth. On May 17, 1980, General Chun Doo-hwan forced the Cabinet to extend martial law to the whole nation, which had previously not applied to Jeju-do. The expanded martial law closed universities, banned political activities and further curtailed the press. To enforce the martial law, troops were dispatched to various parts of the nation. On the same day, KCIA raided a national conference of student union leaders from 55 universities.

zh.s: 五一七军事政变发生于韩国，是全斗焕将军和韩会组织的军事政变，接续于十二月十二日政变之后。1980年5月17日，全斗焕将军迫使内阁把戒严令扩大到全国，此前济州道不在戒严范围内。扩大戒严后，大学关闭、政治活动被禁，新闻审查进一步收紧。军队被派往全国各地执行戒严。当日，中央情报部还突袭了由55所大学学生会负责人参加的全国会议。

en.s: The 1980 Coppa Italia final was the final of the 1979–80 Coppa Italia. The match was played on 17 May 1980 between Roma and Torino. Roma won 3–2 on penalties after a 0–0 draw after extra time.

zh.s: 1980年意大利杯决赛是1979—80赛季意大利杯的决赛，于1980年5月17日由罗马队对阵都灵队。双方在加时赛后仍以0比0战平，罗马最终在点球大战中以3比2获胜。

en.t: 1981 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final
en.s: The 1981 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played at Semple Stadium on 17 May 1981 to determine the winners of the 1980–81 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, the 11th season of the All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champion clubs of the four provinces of Ireland.

zh.t: 1981年全爱尔兰高级俱乐部式曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1981年全爱尔兰高级俱乐部式曲棍球锦标赛决赛于1981年5月17日在森普尔体育场举行，决出1980—81赛季冠军。这是该赛事第11个赛季。赛事由盖尔运动协会主办，参赛俱乐部是爱尔兰四个省级赛事的冠军。

en.s: The May 17 Agreement of 1983 was an agreement signed between Lebanon and Israel during the Lebanese Civil War on May 17, 1983, after Israel invaded Lebanon to end cross border attacks and besieged Beirut in 1982. It called for the withdrawal of the Israeli Army from Beirut and provided a framework for the establishment of normal bilateral relations between the two countries.

zh.s: 1983年5月17日协议是在黎巴嫩内战期间由黎巴嫩和以色列签署的协议。此前，以色列于1982年入侵黎巴嫩，称目的是制止跨境袭击，并围困贝鲁特。协议要求以色列军队撤出贝鲁特，并为两国建立正常双边关系提供框架。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Iran on 15 April 1984, with a second round on 17 May. The majority of seats were won by independents, whilst the Islamic Republican Party was the only party to win seats. Voter turnout was 65.1% in the first round. The Freedom Movement of Iran declared that it would boycott the elections after its headquarters was attacked and the authorities refused to permit the party to hold two seminars.

zh.s: 伊朗于1984年4月15日举行议会选举，5月17日进行第二轮投票。独立候选人赢得多数席位，伊斯兰共和党是唯一赢得席位的政党。首轮投票率为65.1%。伊朗自由运动宣布抵制选举，原因是其总部遭到袭击，且当局不准该党举行两场研讨会。

en.s: The USS Stark incident occurred during the Iran–Iraq War in the Persian Gulf on 17 May 1987, when an Iraqi jet aircraft fired two Exocet missiles at the U.S. frigate USS Stark. A total of 37 United States Navy personnel were killed or later died as a result of the attack, and 21 were injured. Iraq apologized, and Saddam Hussein said that the pilot mistook the frigate for an Iranian tanker.

zh.s: 1987年5月17日，两伊战争期间，波斯湾上的一架伊拉克军机向美国护卫舰“斯塔克”号发射了两枚飞鱼导弹。共有37名美国海军人员当场死亡或后来因袭击伤重不治，另有21人受伤。伊拉克表示道歉，萨达姆·侯赛因称飞行员误把这艘护卫舰当成伊朗油轮。

en.s: The 1987 Hamburg state election was held on 17 May 1987 to elect members of the 13th Hamburg Parliament. It was the first time in nine years that the FDP has held a seat in the parliament, which resulted in a social-liberal coalition.

zh.s: 1987年汉堡州选举于1987年5月17日举行，选出汉堡第13届议会的议员。这是自由民主党（FDP）九年来首次在议会获得席位，选后组成了社会自由主义联盟政府。

en.s: Elections to Belfast City Council were held on 17 May 1989 on the same day as the other Northern Irish local government elections. The election used nine district electoral areas to elect a total of 51 councillors, most representing the more heavily populated north and west. The UUP remained the largest party, and Reg Empey became the Lord Mayor.

zh.s: 贝尔法斯特市议会选举于1989年5月17日举行，与北爱尔兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。选举分为九个地区选区，共选出51名议员，其中多数来自人口较多的北部和西部。阿尔斯特统一党仍是最大党，雷格·恩佩成为市长。

en.s: Elections to Larne Borough Council were held on 17 May 1989 on the same day as the other Northern Irish local government elections. The election used three district electoral areas to elect a total of 15 councillors.

zh.s: 拉恩自治市议会选举于1989年5月17日举行，与北爱尔兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。选举分为三个地区选区，共选出15名议员。

en.s: Elections to Carrickfergus Borough Council were held on 17 May 1989 on the same day as the other Northern Irish local government elections. The election used three district electoral areas to elect a total of 15 councillors.

en.s: The 1990 Greek Cup final was the 46th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 17 May 1990 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were OFI and Olympiacos. It was OFI's second Greek Cup final in their 65 years of existence and Olympiacos' twenty-fifth Greek Cup final in their 65-year history.

zh.s: 1990年希腊杯决赛是该赛事第46届决赛，于1990年5月17日在奥林匹克体育场举行。参赛双方是OFI克里特和奥林匹亚科斯。对OFI克里特而言，这是建队65年来第二次闯入希腊杯决赛；奥林匹亚科斯则在建队65年间第25次闯入决赛。

en.s: WrestleWar '92 was the fourth and final WrestleWar professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). It took place on May 17, 1992, from the Jacksonville Memorial Coliseum in Jacksonville, Florida in the United States. In 1993, WrestleWar was replaced by Slamboree as the May PPV and the event’s WarGames match moved to September’s Fall Brawl. Ten matches were contested at the event including one dark match.

zh.s: 《摔角战争92》是世界摔角冠军赛（WCW）举办的第四届、也是最后一届《摔角战争》付费电视赛事。赛事于1992年5月17日在美国佛罗里达州杰克逊维尔纪念体育馆举行。1993年起，五月付费赛事改为《Slamboree》，而《WarGames》比赛则移至九月的《Fall Brawl》。本届共进行了十场比赛，其中一场未在电视转播中播出。

en.s: General elections were held in Malawi on 17 May 1994. Following the restoration of democracy the previous year, they were the first multi-party elections in the country since prior to independence in 1964. The elections for President and the National Assembly were both won by the United Democratic Front (UDF), ending the 30-year rule of the Malawi Congress Party (MCP). Former President-for-life Hastings Banda, in power since independence, was defeated in the one-round presidential election by the UDF's Bakili Muluzi.

zh.s: 马拉维于1994年5月17日举行大选。前一年恢复民主制度后，这是该国自1964年独立前以来首次举行多党选举。统一民主阵线赢得总统和国民议会选举，结束马拉维大会党长达30年的统治。自独立以来一直掌权的前任终身总统海斯廷斯·班达，在仅举行一轮的总统选举中败给统一民主阵线候选人巴基利·穆卢齐。

en.s: The 1994 Anchorage mayoral election was held on May 2 and May 17, 1994, to elect the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. It saw the election of Rick Mystrom. Since no candidate had received 40% of the vote in the first round (which at least one candidate was required to obtain to avoid a runoff), a runoff was held between the top-two finishers.

zh.s: 1994年安克雷奇市长选举于1994年5月2日和5月17日举行，选出阿拉斯加州安克雷奇市长，最终由里克·米斯特罗姆当选。首轮没有候选人获得至少40%的选票（候选人需达到这一比例才能避免第二轮选举），因此得票最高的两名候选人进入第二轮。

en.s: The 48th Cannes Film Festival was held on May 17-28, 1995. The Palme d'Or went to Underground by Emir Kusturica. The festival opened with La Cité des enfants perdus, directed by Jean-Pierre Jeunet and closed with The Quick and the Dead, directed by Sam Raimi.

zh.s: 第48届戛纳电影节于1995年5月17日至28日举行。埃米尔·库斯图里卡执导的《地下》获得金棕榈奖。电影节以让-皮埃尔·热内执导的《童梦失魂夜》开幕，以山姆·雷米执导的《致命快感》闭幕。

en.s: Jacques René Chirac (UK: , US: ; French: [ʒak ʁəne ʃiʁak] ; 29 November 1932 – 26 September 2019) was President of France from 1995 to 2007. He was previously Prime Minister of France from 1974 to 1976 and 1986 to 1988, as well as Mayor of Paris from 1977 to 1995. After attending the École nationale d'administration, Chirac began his career as a high-level civil servant, entering politics shortly thereafter.

zh.s: 雅克·勒内·希拉克（法语：[ʒak ʁəne ʃiʁak]；1932年11月29日—2019年9月26日）于1995年至2007年担任法国总统。他此前于1974年至1976年、1986年至1988年担任法国总理，并于1977年至1995年担任巴黎市长。希拉克毕业于国家行政学院后，先从高级公务员做起，不久便投身政界。

en.s: The Buffalo Invasion was a professional wrestling live event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW) on May 17, 1997. zh.s: 《布法罗入侵》是极限冠军摔角（ECW）于1997年5月17日举办的一场职业摔角现场赛事，地点在美国纽约州布法罗的伯特·弗利金格中心。赛事片段于5月22日在联合播出的电视节目《ECW Hardcore TV》第213集中播出，整场赛事后来以VHS和DVD发行。

en.s: The 1997 FA Cup final was the 116th final of the FA Cup. It took place on 17 May 1997 at Wembley Stadium and was contested by Chelsea and Middlesbrough, the North East club appearing in its first FA Cup Final. Chelsea won 2–0 to win the FA Cup for the second time, the first having come in 1970. It was also the club's first major trophy in 26 years.

zh.s: 1997年英格兰足总杯决赛是第116届足总杯决赛，于1997年5月17日在温布利球场举行，由切尔西对阵米德尔斯堡。米德尔斯堡是首度闯入足总杯决赛的东北部球队。切尔西以2比0获胜，第二次赢得足总杯；球队上一次夺冠是在1970年。这也是切尔西时隔26年再次赢得重要赛事冠军。

en.s: The 1998 Slamboree was the sixth Slamboree professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). It took place on May 17, 1998 from The Centrum in Worcester, Massachusetts and featured a double main event. Nine matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Sting and The Giant defeated The Outsiders (Scott Hall and Kevin Nash) to win the WCW World Tag Team Championship.

zh.s: 《Slamboree 1998》是世界摔角冠军赛（WCW）举办的第六届《Slamboree》付费电视职业摔角赛事，于1998年5月17日在马萨诸塞州伍斯特的The Centrum举行，设有两场主赛。本届共进行了九场比赛。主赛中，Sting和The Giant击败The Outsiders（Scott Hall和Kevin Nash），赢得WCW世界双打冠军。

en.s: The 1998 FA Trophy Final was the 29th final of the FA Trophy, the Football Association's cup competition for levels 5–8 of the English football league system. It was contested by Cheltenham Town and Southport on 17 May 1998 at Wembley, London. Cheltenham Town won the match 1–0 to win the first major silverware in the club's history.

zh.s: 1998年英格兰足总挑战杯决赛是第29届足总挑战杯决赛。该赛事由英格兰足球总会主办，参赛球队来自英格兰足球联赛第五至第八级别。比赛于1998年5月17日在伦敦温布利举行，由切尔滕纳姆镇对阵绍斯波特。切尔滕纳姆镇以1比0获胜，赢得俱乐部历史上首个重要锦标。

en.s: Early general elections for both the Prime Minister and the Knesset were held in Israel on 17 May 1999 following a vote of no confidence in the government; the incumbent Likud Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, ran for re-election. This election was only the second time in Israeli history an election had been held for the Prime Minister's post in addition to elections for the Knesset. The first such election, in 1996 had been an extremely tight contest between Likud's Benjamin Netanyahu on the right, and Labor's Shimon Peres on the left; the right had won by less than one percent (about 29,000 votes).

zh.s: 以色列于1999年5月17日提前举行大选，同时选举总理和议会议员。此前，政府遭遇不信任投票。时任利库德集团总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡竞选连任。这是以色列历史上第二次除议会选举外还举行总理直选。第一次是在1996年，内塔尼亚胡与左翼工党候选人西蒙·佩雷斯竞争十分激烈；右翼阵营最终以不足1%的优势获胜，约领先29,000票。

en.s: The 2003 FA Cup final was the 122nd final of the FA Cup, the world's oldest domestic football cup competition. The final took place on Saturday 17 May 2003 at the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff, in front of a crowd of 73,726. It was the third consecutive year the final was played at the stadium, due to the ongoing reconstruction of Wembley Stadium, the final's usual venue.

zh.s: 2003年英格兰足总杯决赛是第122届足总杯决赛。足总杯是世界上历史最悠久的国内足球杯赛。决赛于2003年5月17日（星期六）在加的夫千禧球场举行，现场观众为73,726人。由于温布利球场仍在重建，决赛连续第三年在千禧球场举行。

en.s: The 2003 Coupe de la Ligue final was a football match played at Stade de France, Saint-Denis on 17 May 2003 that saw Monaco defeat Sochaux 4–1 thanks to goals by Ludovic Giuly (2), Sébastien Squillaci and Dado Prso.

zh.s: 2003年法国联赛杯决赛于2003年5月17日在圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行。摩纳哥以4比1击败索肖，进球者为吕多维克·久利（两球）、塞巴斯蒂安·斯奎拉奇和达多·普尔绍。

en.s: The 2003 Greek Cup final was the 59th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 17 May 2003, at Toumba Stadium. The contesting teams were PAOK and Aris. It was Aris' sixth Greek Cup final in their 89 years of existence and PAOK's sixteenth Greek Cup final in their 77-year history.

zh.s: 2003年希腊杯决赛是该赛事第59届决赛，于2003年5月17日在图姆巴体育场举行。参赛双方是塞萨洛尼基PAOK和阿里斯。对阿里斯而言，这是建队89年来第六次闯入希腊杯决赛；PAOK则在建队77年间第16次闯入决赛。

en.s: The Puntland Crisis (2001–2003) was an armed conflict that took place in the Puntland autonomous state of northeastern Somalia following a leadership dispute between Colonel Abdullahi Yusuf Ahmed and Colonel Jama Ali Jama after the latter had been elected as the region's new president. After Puntland was established in 1998, Colonel Abdullahi Yusuf Ahmed was elected the regions first president, leading a regional transitional government set for two years.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 邦特兰危机（2001—2003年）是发生在索马里东北部自治地区邦特兰的一场武装冲突。冲突源于领导权争端：贾马·阿里·贾马当选该地区新任总统后，与阿卜杜拉希·优素福·艾哈迈德上校发生对立。1998年邦特兰成立后，艾哈迈德当选当地首任总统，并领导为期两年的过渡政府。

en.s: The 2004 Belgian Cup final, took place on 17 May 2004 between Beveren and Club Brugge. It was the 49th Belgian Cup final and was won by Club Brugge. A record 12 Ivorian players were involved in the Final for Beveren (10 starters and 2 subs), while Björn Vleminckx was the only Belgian who played for the runners-up.

zh.s: 2004年比利时杯决赛于2004年5月17日举行，由贝弗伦对阵布鲁日俱乐部。这是第49届比利时杯决赛，布鲁日俱乐部获胜。贝弗伦队共有12名科特迪瓦球员参赛，创下决赛纪录，其中10人首发、2人替补；亚军队中唯一上场的比利时球员是比约恩·弗莱明克斯。

en.s: The 2005 British Columbia general election was held on May 17, 2005, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs) of the Province of British Columbia (BC), Canada. The British Columbia Liberal Party (BC Liberals) formed the government of the province prior to this general election under the leadership of Premier Gordon Campbell.

zh.s: 2005年不列颠哥伦比亚省大选于2005年5月17日举行，选出加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省立法议会议员。大选前，该省由不列颠哥伦比亚自由党（简称BC自由党）执政，戈登·坎贝尔担任省长和党魁。

en.s: The 2005 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on March 8, 2005, with a run-off election on May 17, 2005. In a rematch of the 2001 election, Councilman Antonio Villaraigosa defeated the sitting mayor, James Hahn, becoming the city's first Hispanic mayor since the 19th century. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2005年洛杉矶市长选举于2005年3月8日举行，5月17日进行第二轮投票。安东尼奥·比利亚莱戈萨在2001年选举的重演中击败现任市长詹姆斯·哈恩，成为自19世纪以来该市首位西裔市长。加利福尼亚州的市政选举（包括洛杉矶市长选举）依法不设党派，候选人的党派信息不会列在选票上。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的第二轮选举日期。

en.s: The 2006 Cannes Film Festival ran from 17 May 2006 to 28 May 2006. Twenty films from eleven countries were in competition for the Palme d'Or. The President of the Official Jury was Wong Kar-wai, the first Chinese director to preside over the jury. English director Ken Loach won Palme d'Or, with his movie The Wind That Shakes the Barley. Other winners were Pedro Almodóvar (Best Screenplay, Volver) and Alejandro González Iñárritu (Best Director, Babel). This also marked the first time in three years that no American film, actor, actress, or filmmaker won any awards in Cannes.

zh.s: 第59届戛纳电影节于2006年5月17日至28日举行。共有来自11个国家的20部影片角逐金棕榈奖。主竞赛单元评审团主席是王家卫，他是首位担任该职务的华人导演。英国导演肯·洛奇凭《风吹麦浪》获得金棕榈奖。其他获奖者包括凭《回归》获得最佳编剧的佩德罗·阿莫多瓦，以及凭《巴别塔》获得最佳导演的亚历杭德罗·冈萨雷斯·伊纳里图。该届电影节也是三年来首次没有美国电影、演员或电影人获奖。

en.s: The 2006 UEFA Champions League final was an association football match between Barcelona of Spain and Arsenal of England at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis, Paris, France, on Wednesday, 17 May 2006. It was the final match of the 2005–06 season of Europe's primary cup competition, the UEFA Champions League.

zh.s: 2006年欧洲冠军联赛决赛于2006年5月17日（星期三）在法国巴黎圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行，由西班牙巴塞罗那对阵英格兰阿森纳。这是2005—06赛季欧洲顶级俱乐部杯赛——欧洲冠军联赛的最后一场比赛。

en.s: The 2006 Cupa României final was the 68th final of Romania's most prestigious cup competition. The final was played at the Stadionul Naţional in Bucharest on 17 May 2006 and was contested between Liga I sides Rapid București and Naţional București. The cup was won by Rapid.

zh.s: 2006年罗马尼亚杯决赛是罗马尼亚最高级别杯赛的第68届决赛，于2006年5月17日在布加勒斯特国家体育场举行，由甲级联赛球队布加勒斯特快速队对阵布加勒斯特国民队。快速队最终夺冠。

en.s: The 2007 Danish Cup final were the final and deciding match of the 2006–07 Danish Cup. It took place on Thursday 17 May 2007 at Parken Stadium in Copenhagen. The contesting teams were the 2006–07 Danish Superliga leaders, F.C. Copenhagen, and the current no. 2 in the league, Odense Boldklub. F.C. Copenhagen have won the Cup on three previous occasions (1995, 1997 and 2004).

zh.s: 2007年丹麦杯决赛是2006—07赛季该赛事的决胜场，于2007年5月17日（星期四）在哥本哈根帕肯球场举行。参赛双方是2006—07赛季丹麦超级联赛领头羊哥本哈根足球俱乐部，以及联赛第二名欧登塞足球俱乐部。哥本哈根此前曾三次赢得丹麦杯冠军，分别是在1995年、1997年和2004年。

en.s: The 2008 FA Cup final was an association football match between Cardiff City and Portsmouth held at Wembley Stadium, London, on 17 May 2008. The final was the showpiece match of English football's primary cup competition, the 2007–08 Football Association Challenge Cup (FA Cup), organised by The Football Association. It was the 127th FA Cup Final and the second to be held at the new Wembley Stadium following its redevelopment.

zh.s: 2008年英格兰足总杯决赛于2008年5月17日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由卡迪夫城对阵朴茨茅斯。这场比赛是英格兰主要足球杯赛——英格兰足球总会挑战杯（简称足总杯）2007—08赛季的焦点赛事，由英格兰足球总会主办。这是第127届足总杯决赛，也是温布利球场翻修后第二次承办该项决赛。

en.t: 2008 Communist Party of Bohemia and Moravia leadership election
en.s: The Communist Party of Bohemia and Moravia (KSČM) held a leadership election on 17 May 2008. Zhe incumbent leader Vojtěch Filip was reelected. Filip's rivals were MP Stanislav Grospič, MEP Miloslav Ransdorf and MP Soňa Marková. Grospič was the strongest rival of Filip. Ransdorf didn't take his poor result well. He stated that KSČM is like "Trabant - it will serve but won't excite.

zh.t: 2008 年波希米亚和摩拉维亚共产党领导人选举
zh.s: 波希米亚和摩拉维亚共产党（KSČM）于 2008 年 5 月 17 日举行领导人选举。现任领导人沃伊捷赫·菲利普再次当选。竞争者包括众议员斯坦尼斯拉夫·格罗皮奇、欧洲议会议员米洛斯拉夫·兰斯多夫和众议员索尼娅·马尔科娃。格罗皮奇是菲利普最有力的对手。兰斯多夫对自己的得票结果不满，称 KSČM 就像“特拉班特——能用，但不令人兴奋”。

en.s: The 2008 Greek Cup final was the 64th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 17 May 2008 at Kaftanzoglio Stadium. The contesting teams were Olympiacos and Aris. It was Olympiacos' thirty-third Greek Cup final in their 83 years of existence and Aris' eighth Greek Cup final in their 94-year history. It was the final match for referee Giorgos Kasnaferis, who officiated four of the last eight cup finals.

zh.s: 2008年希腊杯决赛是该赛事第64届决赛，于2008年5月17日在卡夫坦佐格里奥体育场举行。参赛双方是奥林匹亚科斯和阿里斯。对奥林匹亚科斯而言，这是建队83年来第33次闯入希腊杯决赛；阿里斯则在建队94年间第8次进入决赛。这也是裁判乔治斯·卡斯纳费里斯执法的最后一场比赛；此前八届决赛中，他执法过四场。

en.s: Judgment Day (2009), a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE), took place on May 17, 2009, at the Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois. It was the eleventh and final show under the Judgment Day name and the tenth show held annually; it featured talent from the Raw, SmackDown, and ECW brands. The event's card featured seven matches. The main event for the show saw Edge successfully defend the World Heavyweight Championship against Jeff Hardy. WWE Champion Randy Orton was disqualified in a match against Batista and therefore retained his title. In addition, John Cena defeated Big Show.

zh.s: 《审判日》（2009）是世界摔角娱乐（WWE）制作的职业摔角付费点播赛事，于2009年5月17日在伊利诺伊州罗斯蒙特的全州体育馆举行。这是第11届、也是最后一届以《审判日》为名的赛事，并是该系列按年举办的第10场。Raw、SmackDown和ECW三个品牌的选手参加了赛事，共有7场比赛。主赛中，埃奇成功卫冕世界重量级冠军，击败杰夫·哈迪。WWE冠军兰迪·奥顿在对阵巴蒂斯塔的比赛中因犯规被判负，因此保住冠军头衔。约翰·塞纳还击败了大秀哥。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Lithuania on 17 May 2009. A run-off election would have been held on 7 June 2009 had one been necessary. European Commissioner Dalia Grybauskaitė was elected with 69 percent of the valid vote and took office on 12 July as the country's first female president.

zh.s: 立陶宛于2009年5月17日举行总统选举。如有需要，第二轮投票原定于2009年6月7日举行。欧盟委员会委员达莉娅·格里包斯凯特以69%的有效选票当选，并于7月12日就任立陶宛首位女总统。

en.s: The 2009 Conference Premier play-off final, known as the 2009 Blue Square Premier play-off final for sponsorship purposes, was a football match between Cambridge United and Torquay United on 17 May 2009 at Wembley Stadium in London. It was the seventh Conference Premier play-off final and the third to be played at Wembley Stadium. Torquay won the match 2–0 to secure promotion to League Two, thus returning to The Football League after a two-year absence.

zh.t: 2009年英格兰全国联赛附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2009年英格兰全国联赛附加赛决赛因赞助原因也称为2009年Blue Square Premier附加赛决赛，于2009年5月17日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由剑桥联对阵托基联。这是第七届英格兰全国联赛附加赛决赛，也是第三次在温布利球场举行。托基联以2比0获胜，升入英乙，结束了球队为期两年的英格兰足球联赛缺席期。

en.s: The 2009 KNVB Cup final was a football match between Heerenveen and FC Twente on 17 May 2009 at De Kuip, Rotterdam. It was the final match of the 2008–09 KNVB Cup competition. Heerenveen beat FC Twente on penalties after the match finished 2–2 after extra time. It was the side's first KNVB Cup trophy.

zh.s: 2009年荷兰杯决赛于2009年5月17日在鹿特丹德奎普球场举行，由海伦芬对阵特温特，是2008—09赛季荷兰杯的决赛。双方在加时赛后以2比2战平，海伦芬在点球大战中获胜，首次赢得荷兰杯。

en.s: Pamir Airways Flight 112 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Kunduz Airport, Kunduz to Kabul International Airport in Kabul, Afghanistan. On 17 May 2010, the flight operated by an Antonov An-24 crashed into terrain shortly before it was scheduled to land in Kabul, killing all 39 passengers and 5 crew.

zh.t: 帕米尔航空112号班机空难
zh.s: 帕米尔航空112号班机是阿富汗国内定期客运航班，从昆都士机场飞往喀布尔的喀布尔国际机场。2010年5月17日，这架由安东诺夫安-24执飞的航班在即将按计划降落喀布尔前撞地坠毁，机上39名乘客和5名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: The Datta Khel incident was a skirmish that took place between a United States helicopter and Pakistani forces took place in the Datta Khel area on May 17, 2011. According to NATO, an American encampment along the Afghanistan-Pakistan border took direct and indirect fire from Pakistan. Two United States helicopters flew into the area. According to the Pakistani military, the helicopters had breached its airspace.

zh.s: 达塔赫尔事件是2011年5月17日发生在达塔赫尔地区的一场冲突，涉及一架美国直升机和巴基斯坦军方。北约称，巴基斯坦向阿富汗—巴基斯坦边境沿线的一处美军营地发动直接和间接火力攻击，随后两架美国直升机飞入该地区。巴基斯坦军方则称，这些直升机侵犯了巴基斯坦领空。

en.s: The Magyar Kupa final was the final match of the 2010–11 Magyar Kupa, played between Kecskemét and Videoton.

en.s: The 2011 Colorado Springs mayoral election took place on May 17 and April 5, 2011, to elect the mayor of Colorado Springs, Colorado. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections. The election was officially nonpartisan. This was the first mayor to elect a mayor of Colorado Springs to function under the strong mayor style of governance.

zh.t: 2011年科罗拉多斯普林斯市长选举
zh.s: 2011年科罗拉多斯普林斯市长选举于4月5日和5月17日举行，选出科罗拉多州科罗拉多斯普林斯市长。选举与当地其他选举同期举行，依法不设党派。这是该市首次通过选举产生一位在强市长制度下履职的市长。

en.s: The 2012 UEFA Women's Champions League final was the final match of the 2011–12 UEFA Women's Champions League, the 11th season of the UEFA Women's Champions League football tournament and the third since it was renamed from the UEFA Women's Cup. The match was held in the Olympiastadion in Munich, Germany on 17 May 2012. Lyon won the tournament, beating Frankfurt 2–0 to retain the trophy.

zh.s: 2012年欧洲女子冠军联赛决赛是2011—12赛季该赛事的决赛，也是赛事第11个赛季、从欧洲女子联盟杯更名后的第三个赛季。比赛于2012年5月17日在德国慕尼黑奥林匹克体育场举行。里昂以2比0击败法兰克福，夺得冠军并成功卫冕。

en.s: The 2012 Danish Cup final was a football match that decided the winner of the 2011–12 Danish Cup. It was played on 17 May 2012 at 18:00 CEST.

zh.s: 2012年丹麦杯决赛决出了2011—12赛季丹麦杯冠军，于2012年5月17日18时（中欧夏令时）举行。

en.s: The 2013 Copa del Rey final was the 111th final since the tournament's establishment (including two seasons where two rival editions were played). The match was a Madrid derby between Real Madrid and Atlético Madrid on 17 May 2013 at the Santiago Bernabéu Stadium in Madrid. It was the clubs' first meeting in the final since 1992 when Atlético won 2–0 over Real Madrid.

zh.s: 2013年西班牙国王杯决赛是该赛事创办以来的第111届决赛（其中有两个赛季曾同时举办两项彼此竞争的赛事）。这场比赛是皇家马德里与马德里竞技之间的马德里德比，于2013年5月17日在马德里的伯纳乌球场举行。两队上一次在决赛中交手是在1992年，当时马德里竞技以2比0击败皇家马德里。

en.s: The 2013 En Busca de un Ídolo (Spanish for "In search of an idol") was a professional wrestling tournament held by Mexican professional wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL). CMLL held their second annual En Busca de un Ídolo tournament in 2013, from May 17 until July 21, 2013 with all matches taking place in CMLL's main building, Arena México.

zh.s: 2013年《寻找偶像》（西班牙语意为“寻找一位偶像”）是墨西哥职业摔角推广组织世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的一项锦标赛。CMLL于2013年5月17日至7月21日举行第二届年度赛事，所有比赛都在该组织的主场墨西哥竞技场进行。

en.s: War of the Worlds was a professional wrestling supershow co-produced by the American Ring of Honor (ROH) and Japanese New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) promotions. The event took place on May 17, 2014, at the Hammerstein Ballroom in New York City, New York, United States and aired live on internet pay-per-view (iPPV) through Ustream. All matches on the iPPV featured wrestlers from ROH taking on wrestlers from NJPW. As a result, bookers from both promotions worked together to put the event together. The event featured nine matches with five championships on the line; three from ROH and two from NJPW.

zh.s: 《世界之战》是由美国职业摔角联盟荣誉之环（ROH）和日本新日本职业摔角（NJPW）联合举办的职业摔角特别赛事。比赛于2014年5月17日在美国纽约市的汉默斯坦舞厅举行，并通过Ustream互联网付费点播直播。付费点播直播中的所有比赛都是ROH摔角手对阵NJPW摔角手，因此两家联盟的赛事策划人员共同筹备。赛事共有9场比赛，争夺5个冠军头衔，其中3个属于ROH，2个属于NJPW。

en.s: The 2014 Scottish Cup Final was the 129th final of the Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The match took place at Celtic Park on 17 May 2014 and was contested by Dundee United and St Johnstone. The usual venue, Hampden Park, was unavailable because it was being refurbished for the 2014 Commonwealth Games.

zh.s: 2014年苏格兰杯决赛是苏格兰杯第129届决赛。苏格兰杯是苏格兰最重要的淘汰制足球赛事。比赛于2014年5月17日在凯尔特人公园球场举行，由邓迪联对阵圣约翰斯通。赛事通常举办地汉普顿公园球场当时正在翻修，以备战2014年英联邦运动会。

en.s: The 2014 FA Cup final was an association football match between Premier League clubs Arsenal and Hull City at Wembley Stadium in London, England, on 17 May 2014. It was the 133rd FA Cup final overall and the showpiece match of English football's primary cup competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup (FA Cup), organised by the Football Association (FA).

zh.s: 2014年英格兰足总杯决赛于2014年5月17日在英格兰伦敦温布利球场举行，由英超俱乐部阿森纳对阵赫尔城。这是第133届英格兰足总杯决赛。赛事由英格兰足球总会主办，是英格兰主要足球杯赛——足球总会挑战杯的决赛。

en.t: 2014 Lao People's Liberation Army Air Force An-74 crash
en.s: On 17 May 2014, an Antonov An-74 transport aircraft of the Lao People's Liberation Army Air Force crashed while en route to Xiangkhouang Province, northern Laos, killing all but one of the 17 people on board. Among the victims were several Laotian politicians travelling to attend a ceremony celebrating the 55th anniversary of the second division of the Lao People's Army.

zh.t: 2014年老挝人民解放军空军安-74坠机事故
zh.s: 2014年5月17日，老挝人民解放军空军一架安东诺夫安-74运输机在飞往老挝北部川圹省途中坠毁，机上17人中除1人外全部遇难。遇难者中有数名老挝政治人物，他们当时正前往参加老挝人民军第二师成立55周年纪念仪式。

en.s: The 2014 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 2013–14 DFB-Pokal, the 71st season of Germany's premier football cup. It was played on 17 May at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. In the final, Borussia Dortmund played Bayern Munich. The winners would have earned a place in the group stage of the 2014–15 UEFA Europa League, but both teams had already qualified for the 2014–15 UEFA Champions League via their league positions.

zh.s: 2014年德国杯决赛决出了2013—14赛季德国杯冠军，这是德国顶级足球杯赛的第71个赛季。决赛于5月17日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行，由多特蒙德对阵拜仁慕尼黑。冠军原本可获得2014—15赛季欧洲联赛小组赛席位，但两队都已凭借联赛排名取得2014—15赛季欧洲冠军联赛参赛资格。

en.s: Payback (2015) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by WWE. It took place on May 17, 2015, at the Royal Farms Arena in Baltimore, Maryland. It was the third event under the Payback chronology, and the first Payback held outside of the Chicago suburb of Rosemont, Illinois. Payback was available for free to new subscribers on WWE's monthly subscription service, the WWE Network in over 140 countries. Nine matches took place at the event, with two matches on the pre-show. In the main event, Seth Rollins defeated Roman Reigns, Dean Ambrose and Randy Orton in a Fatal 4-Way match to retain the WWE World Heavyweight Championship.

zh.s: 2015年《Payback》是WWE制作的职业摔角付费点播赛事，于2015年5月17日在马里兰州巴尔的摩的皇家农场体育馆举行。这是该系列第三场赛事，也是首次在伊利诺伊州芝加哥郊区罗斯蒙特以外举办。WWE网络订阅服务在140多个国家向新订户免费提供赛事。正赛共有9场，另有2场赛前赛。主赛是塞斯·罗林斯在四人淘汰赛中击败罗曼·雷恩斯、迪安·安布罗斯和兰迪·奥顿，卫冕WWE世界重量级冠军。

en.s: The Guerra Revolucionaria (2015) (Spanish for "Revolutionary War") show was a major professional wrestling event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion International Wrestling Revolution Group (IWRG), which took place on May 17, 2015 in Arena Naucalpan, Naucalpan, State of Mexico, Mexico. The main event of the show was a 20-man Battle Royal where the eliminated wrestlers would all remain at ringside and act as "Lumberjacks" to ensure none of the participants left the ring. Each lumberjack would be given a leather straps they were allowed to use on the still-active competitors.

zh.s: 《Guerra Revolucionaria》（西班牙语意为“革命战争”）是墨西哥摔角联盟国际摔角革命团体（IWRG）举办的一场重要职业摔角赛事，于2015年5月17日在墨西哥州瑙卡尔潘的瑙卡尔潘竞技场举行。主赛为20人皇家大战，被淘汰的摔角手仍留在擂台边，充当“伐木工”，防止参赛者离开擂台。伐木工可以用皮带抽打仍在比赛中的选手。

en.s: The 2014–15 Hong Kong FA Cup final was a football match that took place on 17 May 2015 at Mong Kok Stadium, Hong Kong. It was the final match of the 2014–15 Hong Kong FA Cup, a football competition including teams in the Hong Kong Premier League.

zh.s: 2014—15赛季香港足总杯决赛于2015年5月17日在香港旺角大球场举行，是该赛季香港足总杯的最后一场比赛。该项足球赛事由香港超级联赛球队参加。

en.s: The 2015 Conference Premier play-off final, known as the 2015 Vanarama Conference Promotion Final for sponsorship reasons, was a football match between Bristol Rovers and Grimsby Town played on 17 May 2015 at Wembley Stadium in London. It was the thirteenth Conference Premier play-off final, the eighth to be played at Wembley and the first to feature either side.

zh.t: 2015年英格兰全国联赛附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2015年英格兰全国联赛附加赛决赛因赞助原因也称为2015年Vanarama全国联赛升级决赛，于2015年5月17日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由布里斯托尔流浪者对阵格林斯比镇。这是第13届英格兰全国联赛附加赛决赛、第八次在温布利举行，也是两支球队首次闯入该项决赛。

en.s: The 2015 Svenska Cupen Final was played on 17 May 2015. The match was played at Gamla Ullevi, the home ground of IFK Göteborg. It was the first time since 2011 that one of the final teams had a home ground instead of playing at the Friends Arena in Solna National Stadium. It was the first time since 2000 that the final was played in Gothenburg and the first time it was played in Gamla Ullevi.

zh.s: 2015年瑞典杯决赛于2015年5月17日举行，比赛地点是哥德堡IFK的主场老乌利维球场。这是自2011年以来，决赛队伍中首次有球队在自己的主场比赛，而非在索尔纳的友谊竞技场举行决赛。这也是自2000年以来决赛首次在哥德堡举行，并且是首次在老乌利维球场举行。

en.s: The 2015 A-League Grand Final was the tenth A-League Grand Final, and was played on 17 May 2015, at AAMI Park to determine the 2014–15 A-League Champion. The match was contested by the two winning semi-finalists and Big Blue rivals, Melbourne Victory and Sydney FC, who finished the 2014–15 A-League season in first and second position respectively.

zh.t: 2015年澳大利亚足球联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2015年澳大利亚足球联赛总决赛是该赛事第十届总决赛，于2015年5月17日在AAMI公园球场举行，决出2014—15赛季冠军。参赛双方是分别赢得半决赛的两支球队，也是宿敌“蓝色德比”的对手：墨尔本胜利和悉尼FC。两队在该赛季常规赛中分列第一和第二。

en.s: On Tuesday, May 17, 2016, an election was held in Portland, Oregon, to elect the mayor. Ted Wheeler was elected after garnering 54% of the primary vote. Incumbent mayor Charlie Hales did not seek a second term. Portland uses a nonpartisan system for local elections, in which all voters are eligible to participate. All candidates are listed on the ballot without any political party affiliation.

zh.s: 2016年5月17日（星期二），美国俄勒冈州波特兰举行市长选举。泰德·惠勒在初选中获得54%的选票并当选。时任市长查理·黑尔斯没有寻求连任。波特兰地方选举不设党派，所有选民都可参加，候选人以无党派身份列在选票上。

en.s: The 2016 Greek Cup final was the 72nd final of the Greek Cup. It took place on 17 May 2016 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were Olympiacos and AEK Athens. It was Olympiacos' thirty ninth Greek Cup final and second consecutive, in their 91 years of existence and AEK Athens' twenty first Greek Cup final of their 92-year history.

zh.s: 2016年希腊杯决赛是该赛事第72届决赛，于2016年5月17日在奥林匹克体育场举行。参赛双方是奥林匹亚科斯和雅典AEK。对奥林匹亚科斯而言，这是建队91年来第39次闯入希腊杯决赛，也是连续第二年进入决赛；雅典AEK则在建队92年间第21次闯入决赛。

en.s: The 2020 Portland City Commission elections were held on May 17, 2016, and November 8, 2016. 2 positions were up for election, Position 1 and Position 4, respectively.

zh.t: 2016年俄勒冈州波特兰市委员会选举
zh.s: 波特兰市委员会选举分别于2016年5月17日和11月8日举行，原文标题虽写2020年。两个席位参与选举，分别是第1席和第4席。

en.s: The Cupa României final was the final match of the 2015–16 Cupa României, played between Dinamo București and CFR Cluj. CFR Cluj won the match, 5–4 after penalties.

zh.s: 2015—16赛季罗马尼亚杯决赛由布加勒斯特迪纳摩对阵克卢日足球俱乐部。克卢日队在点球大战中以5比4获胜。

en.s: The 2016 Kentucky Democratic presidential primary was held on May 17 in the U.S. state of Kentucky as one of the Democratic Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. On the same day, the Democratic Party held their Oregon primary. The Republican Party held their Kentucky caucuses in early March.

zh.t: 2016年肯塔基州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年肯塔基州民主党总统初选于5月17日在美国肯塔基州举行，是民主党为2016年总统选举举行的初选之一。同日，民主党也在俄勒冈州举行初选。共和党在3月初举行了肯塔基州党团会议。

en.s: The 2016 Oregon Republican presidential primary was held on May 17 in the U.S. state of Oregon as one of the Republican Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. On the same day, the Democratic Party held their Oregon primary and their Kentucky primary, while the Republican Party did not hold any other primaries on that day.

zh.t: 2016年俄勒冈州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年俄勒冈州共和党总统初选于5月17日在美国俄勒冈州举行，是共和党为2016年总统选举举行的初选之一。同日，民主党在俄勒冈州和肯塔基州举行初选；共和党当天没有在其他州举行初选。

en.s: The 2016 Oregon Democratic presidential primary was held on May 17 in the U.S. state of Oregon as one of the Democratic Party's primaries ahead of the 2016 presidential election. On the same day, the Democratic Party held their Kentucky primary, while the Republican Party held their own Oregon primary on that day.

zh.t: 2016年俄勒冈州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2016年俄勒冈州民主党总统初选于5月17日在美国俄勒冈州举行，是民主党为2016年总统选举举行的初选之一。同日，民主党也在肯塔基州举行初选，共和党则在俄勒冈州举行自己的初选。

en.s: A by-election was held in the Cook Islands constituency of Avatiu–Ruatonga–Palmerston on 17 May 2017. The by-election was precipitated by the resignation of Albert Nicholas. It was won by Albert Nicholas.

zh.t: 2017年阿瓦蒂乌—鲁阿通加—帕尔默斯顿选区补选
zh.s: 库克群岛阿瓦蒂乌—鲁阿通加—帕尔默斯顿选区于2017年5月17日举行补选。补选由艾伯特·尼古拉斯辞职引发，最终由尼古拉斯胜出。

en.s: The 2017 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match played on May 17, 2017 in Kharkiv between Shakhtar Donetsk and Dynamo Kyiv. The culmination of the 2016–17 Ukrainian Cup season, this was the fourth time the cup final was held in Kharkiv. The match was the 26th Ukrainian Cup Final since fall of the Soviet Union.

zh.s: 2017年乌克兰杯决赛于2017年5月17日在哈尔科夫举行，由顿涅茨克矿工对阵基辅迪纳摩。这场比赛是2016—17赛季乌克兰杯的收官战，也是苏联解体后第26届乌克兰杯决赛。决赛此前曾四次在哈尔科夫举行。

en.s: The 2017 Coppa Italia final decided the winner of the 2016–17 Coppa Italia, Italy's main football cup. It was played on 17 May 2017 at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome between Juventus and Lazio. Juventus won the match 2–0 with two first-half goals from Dani Alves and Leonardo Bonucci, winning their third consecutive Coppa Italia title and 12th title overall.

zh.s: 2017年意大利杯决赛决出了2016—17赛季意大利杯冠军，这是意大利最重要的足球杯赛。比赛于2017年5月17日在罗马奥林匹克体育场举行，由尤文图斯对阵拉齐奥。尤文图斯以2比0获胜，达尼·阿尔维斯和莱昂纳多·博努奇在上半场各进一球。尤文图斯因此连续第三年夺冠，也是第12次赢得该项赛事。

en.s: The 2019 Danish Cup final was played on 17 May 2019 between FC Midtjylland and Brøndby IF at Parken Stadium, Copenhagen, a neutral ground. The final is the culmination of the 2018–19 Danish Cup, the 65th season of the Danish Cup. Brøndby IF appeared in their 10th Danish Cup final (third consecutive) and were the defending title-holders.

zh.s: 2019年丹麦杯决赛于2019年5月17日举行，由中日德兰足球俱乐部对阵布隆德比足球俱乐部，比赛场地是位于哥本哈根的帕肯球场，为中立场地。这场决赛是2018—19赛季丹麦杯的收官战，也是该赛事第65个赛季的决赛。布隆德比第10次闯入丹麦杯决赛，这是球队连续第三年进入决赛；他们也是卫冕冠军。

en.t: 2020 NCAA Division I men's soccer championship game
en.s: The 2020 NCAA Division I men's soccer championship game (also known as the 2020 NCAA Division I Men's College Cup) was played on May 17, 2021, at WakeMed Soccer Park in Cary, North Carolina and determined the winner of the 2020 NCAA Division I men's soccer tournament, the national collegiate soccer championship in the United States. This was the 62nd edition of the oldest active competition in United States college soccer.

zh.t: 2020年NCAA一级男子足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2020年NCAA一级男子足球锦标赛决赛（也称2020年NCAA男子大学杯）于2021年5月17日在北卡罗来纳州卡里的韦克梅德足球公园举行，决出了2020年NCAA一级男子足球锦标赛、美国大学男子足球全国锦标赛的冠军。这是美国大学足球历史最悠久的现存赛事的第62届比赛。

en.t: 2020 NCAA Division I women's soccer championship game
en.s: The 2020 NCAA Division I women's soccer championship game (also known as the 2020 NCAA Division I Women's College Cup) was played on 17 May 2021 at WakeMed Soccer Park in Cary, North Carolina, and determined the winner of the 2020 NCAA Division I women's soccer tournament, the national collegiate women's soccer championship in the United States. This was the 39th. edition of this tournament organised by the NCAA.

zh.t: 2020年NCAA一级女子足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2020年NCAA一级女子足球锦标赛决赛（也称2020年NCAA女子大学杯）于2021年5月17日在北卡罗来纳州卡里的韦克梅德足球公园举行，决出了2020年NCAA一级女子足球锦标赛、美国大学女子足球全国锦标赛的冠军。这是该赛事第39届。

en.s: The 2022 Portland City Auditor election took place on May 17, 2022, to elect the Auditor of Portland, Oregon in the US. Incumbent Mary Hull Caballero did not seek re-election. A two-way race between longtime government auditor Simone Rede and accountant Brian Setzler resulted in Rede winning with 80.22% of the vote in the primaries, avoiding a general election runoff.

zh.s: 2022年波特兰市审计长选举于2022年5月17日举行，选出美国俄勒冈州波特兰市审计长。现任审计长玛丽·赫尔·卡瓦列罗没有寻求连任。长期担任政府审计员的西蒙娜·雷德与会计师布莱恩·塞茨勒展开两人竞逐，雷德在初选中获得80.22%的选票，因此无需举行大选第二轮。

en.s: The 2022 Portland City Commission elections were held on May 17, 2022, and November 8, 2022. Two positions were up for election. Position 2 and Position 3 were held by Dan Ryan and Jo Ann Hardesty, respectively, who both ran for re-election. Portland has no term-limits on officeholders.

zh.s: 2022年波特兰市委员会选举分两轮举行，日期分别为2022年5月17日和11月8日。两个席位需要改选，分别是由丹·瑞安和乔·安·哈迪斯蒂担任的第2席和第3席；两人均竞选连任。波特兰市公职人员没有任期限制。

en.t: 2023 Bosnia and Herzegovina Football Cup final
en.s: The 2023 Bosnia and Herzegovina Football Cup final was an association football match played at Bilino Polje Stadium in Zenica, Bosnia and Herzegovina, on 17 May 2023. Velež Mostar and Zrinjski Mostar were the finalists, making it the first Mostar derby in a cup final. Zrinjski won the trophy for the second time in the club's history.

zh.s: 2023年波黑足球杯决赛于2023年5月17日在波黑泽尼察的比利诺波列体育场举行。维列兹莫斯塔尔和兹林斯基莫斯塔尔闯入决赛，这是两支莫斯塔尔球队首次在杯赛决赛中交锋。兹林斯基第二次赢得该项赛事冠军。

en.s: Bellator Champions Series 2: Mix vs. Magomedov 2 (also known as Bellator Champions Series Paris) was a mixed martial arts event produced by Bellator MMA, that took place on May 17, 2024, at the Accor Arena in Paris, France.

zh.s: Bellator冠军系列赛第2期：Mix对阵Magomedov二番战（也称Bellator巴黎站）是Bellator综合格斗赛事，由Bellator MMA主办，于2024年5月17日在法国巴黎雅高竞技场举行。

en.s: A leadership election for the Mayors and Independents (STAN) in 2025 was held on 17 May 2025. The incumbent leader Vít Rakušan was elected for another term.

zh.t: 2025年市长与独立人士党领导人选举
zh.s: 市长与独立人士党（STAN）于2025年5月17日举行领导人选举，现任领导人维特·拉库尚再次当选。

en.s: The 2025 FA Cup final was a football match played at Wembley Stadium in London, England, on 17 May 2025 between Crystal Palace and Manchester City that determined the winners of the 2024–25 FA Cup. It was the 144th final of English football's primary cup competition, the Football Association Challenge Cup.

zh.s: 2025年英格兰足总杯决赛于2025年5月17日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由水晶宫对阵曼城，决出2024—25赛季足总杯冠军。这是英格兰主要足球杯赛——英格兰足球总会挑战杯的第144届决赛。

en.s: The 2025 iteration of the Crockett Cup was a professional wrestling tag team tournament produced by the National Wrestling Alliance (NWA). It was the eighth iteration in the Crockett Cup chronology. The event took place on May 17, 2025, at the 2300 Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and aired on tape delay across seven episodes of NWA Powerrr on The Roku Channel.

zh.s: 2025年克罗克特杯是由国家摔角联盟（NWA）举办的职业摔角双打锦标赛，也是该赛事历史上的第八届。本届赛事于2025年5月17日在宾夕法尼亚州费城的2300竞技场举行，并以延迟播出的方式，在Roku频道的《NWA Powerrr》中分七集播出。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Burns vs. Morales
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Burns vs. Morales (also known as UFC Fight Night 256 and UFC Vegas 106 and UFC on ESPN+ 114) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on May 17, 2025, at the UFC Apex in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：伯恩斯对阵莫拉莱斯
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：伯恩斯对阵莫拉莱斯（也称UFC格斗之夜256、UFC拉斯维加斯106和UFC ESPN+ 114）是终极格斗冠军赛主办的综合格斗赛事，于2025年5月17日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex举行。恩特普赖斯位于拉斯维加斯谷地。

en.s: The 2025 OFC Women's Champions League final was the final match of the 2025 OFC Women's Champions League, the 3rd edition of the OFC Women's Champions League, Oceania's premier women's club football tournament organized by the Oceania Football Confederation (OFC). It took place at Stade Pater in Pirae on 17 May 2025. The winner will qualify for the inaugural FIFA Women's Champions Cup to be held in 2026.

zh.t: 2025年大洋洲女子冠军联赛决赛
zh.s: 2025年大洋洲女子冠军联赛决赛是该赛事第3届比赛的决赛。该赛事由大洋洲足球联合会（OFC）主办，是大洋洲最高级别的女子俱乐部足球赛事。决赛于2025年5月17日在皮拉埃的帕特尔体育场举行。冠军将获得参加2026年首届国际足联女子冠军杯的资格。

en.s: The 2025 Greek Cup final was the 81st final of the Greek Cup. It took place on 17 May 2025 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were OFI and Olympiacos. It was OFI's third Greek Cup final in their 100 years of existence and Olympiacos' forty second Greek Cup final of their 100-year history. This was the first final to use semi-automated offside technology and goal-line technology.
